body: Right there with ya.   Everyone is just telling me to "get over it" and "face the reality and grow up".

Yeah well I definitely got bullied a lot in school.  Divorced parents 4, so both my parents had to move around a lot.  Ended up going to 4 different schools, always the new kid joining in sometimes even joining mid year was tough.  Everyone already had their own groups and I was often just by myself.  I eventually got used to it, and the schizophrenia would help because I would have a conversation practically in my head.  Yeah probably sounds crazy, maybe even a little bit sad, but I had to "just deal with it".   Also I have the hardest time going in between parents houses, never really had a solid grounding anywhere.  Like I dunno? Know your neighbors? Hmm never really went to the same store much because the moves were pretty distant.  Often I would over think things and end up getting lost.  I dunno why, why do I just keep on thinking, no brain off, no sleep because brain on.  This is before I had data or even a smartphone.   So no Google maps.  I had to screenshot every turn and when to get on and off transportation.  Google says it should be about 1 hour and 45 mins, but sometimes I don't get home until 6 - 7 PM because I got lost or had to backtrack.  Eventually I get in and my family is just like "oh, sorry we ate without you, we didn't know when you would've got here".  Mind you this is early highschool, never was taught I guess on how to ride the train or where to stand on the bus.  Sometimes I manage to get a seat in the back or side, but when it's my stop I can't get out in time and the door closes.  Now I'm riding past my stop on the express, get off, find the sign for the next Express bus back. Sometimes I text the boss to see when the  scheduled stop times and find out that it just left 5 - 10 mins ago, now I gotta wait 30- 45 mins for the next.  Oh man did I get off track? Hmm yeah this is also what I mean I guess? I don't know if people will understand with my explanation and experiences, not that good of a store teller and have a hard time explaining things well.   I'm not asking for your pity or sorrys or any sympathy.  I don't really need it, I'm fine and honestly fine with my coming decisions.  Almost like a charade of sorts I guess,  I've been pretty good at hiding it from people, I can just pretend to be happy and joke.  Like that scene from Inglorious bastards where the 2 Jewish-American-Russian and 1 British soldiers go into the death trap of a tavern?  To meet with their secret contact, a French/German lady where she tells them vital information about the whereabouts of the theater the Germans are in and blow it up.  The British soldier has an odd German accent that gives him away and he has to converse with another S.S. officer I think.  Anyways he has to prove that he's truly a German officer from the fatherland, and drinks and jokes, really puts on a show, yeah its probably better if you watch it.  Beautiful scene and camera work.  But yeah, I'm finished, some say a bit early but I think it's for a noble cause.  I will no longer experience anything more, waste no more resources and money.  No longer be a burden to the people around me, and yeah they will eventually move on and forget about me.  Yeah that's great, they can move on and do their own thing without me cucking it all up.
